source.source_locator: 教則 第4章 4.1「回転翼航空機（マルチローター）」(1)機体の特徴

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 同一モーター性能なら、ローター数増加は故障耐性とペイロードの向上につながる。
evidence.tested_misconception: ローター数は名称上の違いで、system redundancyやpayloadには影響しない。
evidence.reasoning_path: same motor performance -> rotor count -> redundancy/payload effects

collision.note: LOW。既存Q062は左右移動の回転数制御、Q071はESCでありローター数によるsystem characteristicは未出。

independent_review.rationale: 4.1 states that with equal motor performance, more multirotor rotors improve failure tolerance and payload; no canonical item tests this system-level consequence.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review is source-consistent, preserves second-class scope, and correctly rejects two sensor-fact candidates whose answer-defining propositions are already represented in released questions. The remaining 28 candidates cover distinct Chapter 4 system characteristics, equipment boundaries, sensor principles, powertrain/battery behavior, and radio propagation with useful commercial practice value.
